map.根据螺纹规格和材料类型，计算切削速度、主轴转速和进给量: From thread size and material type, compute cutting speed, spindle speed and feed.
map.H = 0.866×P（理论）；H₁ ≈ 0.5413×P（实际牙高）: H = 0.866 times P (theoretical); H1 approx 0.5413 times P (actual thread depth).
map.基于 ISO 公制 60° 螺纹基本牙型：理论三角形高度 H=0.866P，实际: Based on the ISO metric 60 deg thread fundamental form: theoretical triangle height H=0.866P, actual thread depth H1 approx 0.5413P (about 5/8 of H); for determining thread cutting depth.
map.💡 主轴转速 n = Vc×1000 / (π×D)；进给量 f = 螺距 P: Formula: spindle speed n = Vc times 1000 / (pi times D); feed f = pitch P (mm/r); number of cuts allotted by decreasing pitch.
map.仅支持公制(M)螺纹，粗牙可省略螺距（如 M10）: Only metric (M) threads are supported; for coarse pitch the pitch may be omitted (e.g. M10).
map.切削速度为推荐范围中值，实际需根据刀具和工况调整: The cutting speed is the mid of the recommended range; actual needs adjustment by tool and condition.
map.高速钢刀取低值，硬质合金刀取高值: High-speed steel tools take the low value, carbide tools the high value.
map.📚 深度解析：螺纹加工参数计算（转速、进给与分层进刀）: In-depth: Thread machining parameter calculation (speed, feed and layered cuts)
map.与材料算主轴转速与进给速度: and material compute spindle speed and feed rate.
map.攻丝/车螺纹工艺：确定切削次数与每次进刀深度: Tapping/thread-turning process: determine the number of cuts and each pass depth.
map.区间: ranges of carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminum, etc.
map.算法：按材料取切削速度区间（碳钢 60~80、不锈钢 30~50、铝合金 120: Algorithm: by material take the cutting-speed range (carbon steel 60 to 80, stainless 30 to 50, aluminum 120 to 200, brass 80 to 120, cast iron 70 to 100 m/min); mid Vc = (Vc_min+Vc_max)/2; spindle speed n = Vc times 1000/(pi times nominal diameter); feed per rev = pitch P; thread depth = 0.5413 times P; total infeed = depth times 1.3; number of cuts = ceil(P/0.3)+2; each pass decreases, the first few are average times 1.2, the last cut takes the remainder; feed rate = mid speed times P (mm/min). Speed >2000 rpm warns safety, <100 rpm warns low efficiency.
map.例：M10×1.5 碳钢 → Vc 70m/min、转速 2228rpm（范围: Example: M10x1.5 carbon steel -> Vc 70 m/min, speed 2228 rpm (range 1910 to 2546), feed 1.5 mm/r, feed rate 3342 mm/min, depth 0.812 mm, 7 cuts, each pass 0.181 -> 0.181 -> 0.181 -> 0.181 -> 0.181 -> 0.151 -> 0.000 mm, hint: high speed, mind safety. If M20x2.5 stainless -> Vc 40 m/min, speed 637 rpm, feed 2.5 mm/r, feed rate 1593 mm/min, depth 1.353 mm, 11 cuts, each pass 0.192 times 9 -> 0.032 -> 0.000 mm, hint: moderate speed. If M20x2.5 aluminum -> Vc 160 m/min, speed 2546 rpm, feed rate 6366 mm/min.
map.0.5413×P 是 ISO 公制 60° 螺纹的基本牙型高度 H₁（理论: 0.5413 times P is the fundamental-form height H1 of an ISO metric 60 deg thread (theoretical
map.高为 0.866P，实际牙高约为其 5/8 = 0.5413P）。车削时径向进刀: height 0.866P, actual about 5/8 = 0.5413P). The radial infeed is controlled by this depth, multiplied by 1.3 to account for tool-tip radius and deflection, ensuring a clean root.
map.最后一刀为什么显示 0.000？: Why does the last cut show 0.000?
map.本工具采用「前几刀取平均量×1.2、最后一刀取剩余量」的递减分配，当前几刀已把总: This tool uses decreasing allocation: the first few cuts take average times 1.2 and the last takes the remainder; once the first cuts consume the total stock, the last cut remainder is 0, which in practice is an air cut (finishing pass). This matches real process: the final pass is often a no-depth finishing travel to remove deflection and improve flank quality.
map.螺纹加工参数计算器解析公制螺纹规格（如M10×1.5），根据材料类型推荐切削速度: The thread machining parameter calculator parses a metric thread size (e.g. M10x1.5), recommends the cutting-speed range by material type, computes spindle speed, feed and feed rate, and gives a decreasing per-pass depth allocation.
